beats.title: Table Talk: Play and Tools
beats.boundaryReason: Opening discussion of character relationships, in-person play, and virtual tabletop tools; ends when the topic shifts to Taelgarverse and collaborative worldbuilding.

beats.title: Table Talk: Collaborative Worldbuilding
beats.boundaryReason: Discussion turns to shared worldbuilding, character warm-ups, and future session formats, then winds down into lunch preparations.

beats.title: Table Prep: Transformation Options
beats.boundaryReason: Pre-play discussion explores dragon and leviathan forms, interspersed with lunch, equipment, and Lego conversation; the next beat begins the level-up review.

beats.title: Table Prep: Level Twenty
beats.boundaryReason: Level-twenty abilities, spell choices, and character-sheet preparations form a distinct setup block ending before the DM begins the adventure.

beats.title: Setting Out for Isingue
beats.boundaryReason: Play begins aboard Vindristjarna over Orenlas. Scrying and planar consultation establish the threat, and the party chooses Wind Walk before the journey is narrated.
dateEvidence: Session manifest drStart is 1749-09-17. At u1263-u1268 the party wakes over Orenlas after returning from Limbo.
At u1524-u1528 only a couple of hours of ship travel have elapsed; the Wind Walk departure at u1586-u1589 continues this day.

beats.title: Arrival and the Illusory Scout
beats.boundaryReason: The narrated flight reaches the ash storm, followed by Delwath's illusory reconnaissance and scrying. The next beat switches to Kenzo's direct sensing of the ooze network.
dateEvidence: The Wind Walk journey and arrival at u1700-u1758 continue the departure day established by the manifest.
The subsequent reconnaissance lasts about an hour at u1851-u1854; no overnight transition occurs.

beats.title: Sensing the Ooze and Ash
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo maps the ooze through communion, probes its lack of conscious will, and tests the poisonous ash. The next beat turns to arranging a sample-collection mission.
dateEvidence: This investigation immediately follows the first-day scouting.
At u2375-u2391 the party explicitly places the proposed sample collection before a future overnight camp.

beats.title: Planning the Dragon Reconnaissance
beats.boundaryReason: The party works out a poison-safe reconnaissance plan, selects Wellby as the green dragon, and resolves the transformation's duration before departing.
dateEvidence: This planning directly follows Kenzo's ash test on the arrival day.
The planned long rest at u2384-u2391 has not yet occurred; the next beat places departure near sunset.

beats.title: Collecting an Ooze Sample
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby carries Kenzo into the storm, where Kenzo explores the ruined cistern and briefly fights to obtain a sample. Their return and the reversal of Wellby's transformation close the expedition.
dateEvidence: At u2692-u2719 the reconnaissance begins and the DM describes sunset during the flight.
The expedition returns at u3045-u3048 before the feast and overnight camp later in the same day.

beats.title: The Mirror Reveals the Origins
beats.boundaryReason: The focus shifts to examining the crystal sample and viewing its origins in the mirror, followed by discussion of the river connection as a target.
dateEvidence: The mirror consultation follows the sunset reconnaissance and precedes the explicit camp scene at u3474-u3477.
The historical vision is viewed on the current day; its depicted past does not advance the session date.

beats.title: A Feast Before Rest
beats.boundaryReason: The party commits to attacking the river concentration after resting, prepares Heroes' Feast, sets up camp, and adjusts equipment. The next beat starts with morning.
dateEvidence: At u3401-u3405 the party chooses a long rest before the river attack.
At u3452-u3458 Heroes' Feast is arranged for the night before the attack; u3474-u3477 explicitly place camp and the feast at sunset.

beats.title: Two Leviathans Approach the River
beats.boundaryReason: An explicit morning transition opens a new day. The party approaches along the river in prepared forms, observes the ooze gathering onshore, and positions for combat.
dateEvidence: At u3553-u3564 morning follows the overnight camp, and the storm has expanded during the night.
This is one day after the 1749-09-17 start, matching the approved manifest drEnd of 1749-09-18.

beats.title: The River Battle Begins
beats.boundaryReason: Initiative begins the river battle. Initial attacks and soul sight establish the combatants' capabilities; the next beat begins with discovery of the connecting tendril.
dateEvidence: Initiative at u3875 follows the morning approach without a time jump.
The date remains 1749-09-18 after the explicit waking transition at u3553-u3564.

beats.title: Targeting the Connecting Tendril
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby identifies the connection to the plaza, shifting the objective to severing it. An initial tidal wave fails to break it, Wellby is restrained, and the leviathans reposition.
dateEvidence: This is the next continuous phase of the river battle begun after the 1749-09-18 morning approach; no time transition occurs.

beats.title: Stone Armor and Acid Nets
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo's focused attack prompts the ooze to reinforce and armor the tendril. Kenzo joins Wellby in acid restraints, the party recognizes the retaliation pattern, and Seeker forces a legendary resistance.
dateEvidence: The combat continues uninterrupted from the preceding beat on 1749-09-18.
At u4837-u4840 the players confirm that the overnight long rest has already occurred.

beats.title: Cracks Spread Through the Tendril
beats.boundaryReason: Delwath draws the ooze's attacks as visible cracks begin to form. Kenzo damages the armored connection with force and escapes the net, while Wellby remains restrained and badly hurt.
dateEvidence: These turns directly continue the same river battle on the morning after camp; there is no intervening rest or time jump.

beats.title: Healing and the Final Wave
beats.boundaryReason: Seeker switches to healing Wellby and striking the damaged connection. Delwath's renewed tidal wave severs it, causing the river ooze to collapse and crystallize.
dateEvidence: The concluding turns immediately follow the preceding combat phase on 1749-09-18.
The ooze falls apart at u5495-u5509 during the same encounter.

beats.title: Following the Crystalline Trail
beats.boundaryReason: The battle ends with rumbling from the city. The party frees Wellby, heals, locates the remaining concentration at the well, and prepares to follow the crystal connection overland.
dateEvidence: The aftermath follows the battle immediately, with the leviathan transformations still active at u5565-u5566 and u5603-u5607.
No further rest occurs before the party advances toward the well.

beats.title: The Colossal Ooze Emerges
beats.boundaryReason: The party reaches the collapsed plaza and sees the enormous ooze emerging from the cistern. The recording ends with tactical discussion before initiative for the next encounter.
dateEvidence: At u5739-u5746 the party rushes directly from the river aftermath to the plaza, still on 1749-09-18.
The stop at u5814-u5818 is a real-world break; it does not advance the in-world date or begin the next combat.
